done_when: In Forge's own repo only, pull request CI runs just the Linux test groups (sized so each stays under its time limit); pushes to main and release tags run the full Linux, Mac and Windows matrix; close's named checks still pass on pull requests; the release steps in this repo's docs say to confirm main's full-matrix run is green before tagging; the shipped client workflow is unchanged; this repo's CI tests check the pull-request and main job sets
why: Forge's own CI runs about 17 jobs (3 Linux, 6 Mac, 8 Windows) on every pull request, and the knacklabs organisation shares about 20 runners, so even one Forge pull request leaves client repos' CI queued (2026-10-09). Owner decision: Linux on pull requests, every OS on main and before each release
